chapters.title: Chapter 1: Sign-in system, cornerstone, island monument
chapters.content_html:
"what's going on?"

Xiao Yi looked at the boundless sea in front of him, a little confused.

I looked at the small island two meters square at my feet, and beside me, there was a tree, a stone, a monument, and an old fishing net that was randomly discarded by the sea, that's all.

Xiao Yi thought hard, hoping to understand how he got to this place.

In my impression, as the quality operation specialist, I still report to my beautiful boss in the office building.

A dazzling white light suddenly flashed in the sky, as if a flash bomb had been released from the whole map. When I returned to normal vision, I came to this place.

Trees and stones are common things, and the tattered fishing net by the sea is nothing special.

So, Xiao Yi walked towards the black stele in the middle. He was surprised to find that there was a screen on the stele.

"What is this?" Xiao Yi looked at the screen and observed it carefully.

There are five taskbars above: public channel, private channel, trading floor, map, construction.

Xiao Yi pointed directly to the task bar on the map, he wanted to know what kind of ghost place he was in.

When the map is opened, there is only one bright spot on the entire interface, and a circle around it is lit up.

"Is this the location of my small island, can't see other locations?" Xiao Yi frowned and thought, "Then what is the use of this map?"

Then he clicked on the other four taskbars in turn, and found that they were all blank.

"This interface looks like a game interface?" Xiao Yi said to himself.

Suddenly the stele lit up, Xiao Yi nervously took a step back, and seeing that there was no other abnormality in the stele, he leaned forward and took a closer look.

On the public channel, text appeared.

"What's the situation? Why did you suddenly come to the sea?"

With the appearance of this sentence, a stone stirred up a thousand waves, and the public channel immediately became lively.

"Yeah, ask the same question, I haven't had breakfast yet, I'm starving to death."

"Is there a big eagle's explanation? Land ducks are so panic! In such a small place, a wave will come and it will be completely submerged."

"I want to go home, I want to find my mother! Woohoo..."

Seeing the content on the public channel, Xiao Yi realized that he should not be alone in this **** sea.

"Don't waste time, hurry up and fetch the material boxes on the sea, the boxes have the materials we need!" Someone suddenly said on the public channel.

After this sentence came out, the public channel immediately stopped a lot, presumably many people went to find the material box!

Xiao Yi immediately walked to the beach and saw a box about one meter cube not far away.

"How to get it here?" Xiao Yi saw the fishing net beside him, "Is this a test of our survivability?"

No matter, for now, let's make sure that he lives first, Xiao Yi grabs the fishing net.

But he looked at the fishing net in his hand and didn't know how to use it?

He is just an ordinary company employee, how can he cast a net for such a professional thing.

Give it a try!

Xiao Yi lifted the fishing net and threw it at the material box.

The fishing net flew past like a ball of thread, then landed next to the supply box, and slowly sank into the sea.

Can't let go at all!

Come again!

Still a bunch of threads flew out!

Come again!

still the same!

"Do you want to swim over?" Xiao Yi frowned, but he only knew how to dig, and he wasn't very familiar with it.

In the swimming pool, you can still flutter twice, in the sea, forget it! Swim past and die faster!

Xiao Yi looked closer to the sea and found that even the sea seemed to be bottomless. Could it be that his island is a cylinder protruding from the bottom of the sea?

"Di, the sign-in system is activated!"

Just when Xiao Yi was struggling, a voice suddenly sounded in his mind.

"What? Sign-in? System?" Xiao Yi was already stunned by this series of unusual blows.

"Sign in successfully and get a fully automatic fishing net."

Xiao Yi was a little stunned: "Is it crazy to think about fishing nets? Where are the automatic fishing nets?"

"The items obtained from signing in will be stored in the system space, please collect them yourself." Another voice sounded.

"System space?" Xiao Yi's eyes widened, "System!"

Although he is still a little confused, Xiao Yi already understands that he has won the grand prize.

"Take out the fully automatic fishing net!" Xiao Yi tried to say, a small car suddenly appeared in front of him.

"Fully automatic fishing net, SS-level tool, as long as you set its patrol route and target, you can pull back the target within 320 meters around the route!"

Xiao Yi's eyes widened again. There was an explanation message on the car, and he hurriedly looked at other objects.

"Worn fishing net: Class D tool, a fishing net that has been tattered, I can only pray that the things it catches will not miss! The maximum catch radius is 10 meters."

"Pulverum tree: cut it down to get some wood, leaves and bark."

"Stones: After mining, you can get some stones."

"Island Monument: With it, it will be very convenient to develop, without it, it is impossible to move an inch, unless you are strong enough to not need it, otherwise, for safety, you should protect it!"

There are explanatory messages on everything, but the things defined as island monuments are a bit confusing to Xiao Yi!

Although I don't know if the information that suddenly appeared on the item is the function of the system, Xiao Yi knew that it was time for him to act.

He walked quickly to the edge of the fully automatic fishing net and began to set up patrol routes on it.

At present, we can only patrol around the edge of the two-meter-square island. The target object is naturally set as a material box. Through the camera function that comes with the car, the nearest material box is photographed.

With the image, the fully automatic fishing net can identify the target itself and capture it!

Set up, run!

The fully automatic fishing net moved immediately.

puff! A fishing net suddenly spewed out from the square stomach of the trolley, like a big mouth. It accurately netted the nearest material box, and then retracted the net and pulled it back. The whole process took less than ten seconds!

"It's still fully automatic and easy to use!" Xiao Yi sighed, just now he was so tired that he didn't cast the net, and now he just needs to stand by and watch the machine cast the net.

After pulling back to the shore, the fishing net was automatically retracted, and the fully automatic fishing net made a beeping sound, and then continued to move according to the patrol line.

Xiao Yi immediately walked to the material box.

"Material box: what you can open depends on luck, pray for good luck!"

Xiao Yi pulled off the waterproof tape and opened the box.

"Get: cornerstone*2, wood*2, mineral water 500ml*2, bread 100g*1."

"Good stuff!" Xiao Yi saw that there was food and water, and his eyes lit up instantly. If you want to survive, you must have food and water, and everything else is secondary!

But when Xiao Yi turned his eyes to the two cornerstones, he suddenly stopped thinking that way.

"The cornerstone can expand the area of ​​​​the island by 1 square meter. Note: Be sure to expand the area of ​​your island as soon as possible. The sea water will submerge 1 square meter of the island area every week!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Expanded island with graded apple soil
chapters.content_html:
Seeing this information, Xiao Yi's eyes widened, one square meter a week, then this small island can only be submerged all around!

The consequences after the submersion can be imagined. A person can last five or six days in the sea without encountering any danger.

But all kinds of creatures in the sea will never let you float for five or six days so comfortably.

"How to use this cornerstone?" Xiao Yi frowned and looked at the two small stones that could be grasped with one hand. He felt that when thrown into the sea, it would disappear immediately. Even a splash of water could not be splashed. How could it be possible to destroy the island? Expand the area by one square meter?

"Island tablet, build the page." It seemed that he heard Xiao Yi's muttering, and the system prompted.

Xiao Yi immediately took the two cornerstones and took one step towards the island monument.

At this time, the public channel was lively again.

"What the hell, I'm not a fisherman, I don't know how to use a fishing net, I can't cast it at all!"

"It doesn't matter if it's a fisherman. This fishing net is too broken. Even if the net is caught, it will leak when you pull it back! I've missed it three times!"

"I don't think the distance is too far, why don't you just swim over and push it back!"

"Yeah, swimming is more reliable than using that broken fishing net. I'll go into the water first and wait for the news of my victory!"

Xiao Yi just glanced at it, ignored their discussion, and clicked on the construction interface.

The originally empty construction interface finally appeared with content.

[Expanding the island] Materials required: cornerstone per square meter * 1.

【Stone Axe】Required materials: stone*1, wood*1, hemp rope*1.

[Board] Materials required: wood*3.

......

Only the expansion of the island lit up, and the rest were dark, presumably because of lack of materials.

Xiao Yi did not hesitate to point to the first expansion island.

"Consume a cornerstone and expand by one square meter, please confirm the expansion location!"

At this time, a three-dimensional image of the island appeared on the island tablet interface, and Xiao Yi clicked on the edge.

"Successful expansion!"

One of the cornerstones in Xiao Yi's hand disappeared. He turned to look at the location he chose to expand, and found that there really was a space of about one square meter!

"Who the **** did this island monument come up with?" Xiao Yi was secretly shocked, which completely subverted his three views.

Although it is unbelievable, Xiao Yi has no other way at present, and can only follow the rules here.

Xiao Yi no longer hesitated and used another cornerstone to expand the island.

Now Xiao Yi's island has changed from 2*2 at the beginning to 2*3, and it has become a rectangle.

After the expansion, Xiao Yi switched to the public channel again.

"Did that old man come back from swimming before?"

"I'm afraid I won't be able to come back. I saw a shark near the material box, so I didn't dare to go down!"

"Can I wait for the supply box to be pushed to the shore with the waves?"

"Are you thinking about peach? They will only drift farther and farther. The material box closest to me has drifted farther! Even if you give me a complete fishing net now, I can't reach it!"

At this moment, the person who said he was going to swim over spoke again.

"Hoo, my Cao, I'm back!"

"Brother, did you really push the material box back?"

"Push a wool, there is a two-meter-long sea snake near the material box. Although I didn't see whether it was poisonous, I dare not approach it!"

"That's it, I feel that there are dangerous marine creatures near each material box, what can I do?"

"very hungry!"

"I'm so thirsty!"

"I have an idea, you can trade the fishing net to me. The two broken fishing nets should be able to be combined into a complete fishing net, so that I can trade it back for free after I get the supplies from the net! If you trust me, I will initiate a trade with me, but if you don't trust me, forget it. ."

The man who previously claimed to be a fisherman spoke again on the public channel.

Xiao Yi glanced at his ID, Li Yu.

The reason why I didn't say it was that person's name was because there were a lot of people's names on the public channel, just like the names used in online games.

Of course there are also many that look like real names.

Although Li Yu proposed such a plan, no one responded to him.

After all, everyone doesn't know each other. This fishing net is related to their own survival. No one will easily trade it to others, even though it is just a broken fishing net.

"Haha, I've got a material box, wait for me to open it and see what's inside!" said a person whose ID is Dilintianxia on the public channel.

After a while, Di Lintian said again: "Great, there is a bottle of 500ml mineral water and 100g of bread!"

"Boss, can you trade me a bite of bread? Please, I'm so hungry that my chest is on my back!"

"Boss, take a sip of water, I'm dying of thirst!"

"Don't think about food and water. What I can tell you is, hurry up and use the things around you to make something that can collect material boxes, or you will die!" Di Lintian said, like educating the younger generation.

"Big tree and big stone, even if these two things can make something, they need tools, or do they use fingernails?"

"Yeah, what's up with this?"

"Don't you guys use a slightly thicker branch, then take apart the fishing net, tie it into a triangle, and put the material box on it like playing with a loop? Although the success rate is lower, it is finally successful. The odds!" Di Lintian replied.

"Good idea, thank you, boss! I have to make it quickly, the material box has drifted farther and farther!"

Xiao Yi watched their chat and secretly said: "Sure enough, everyone was forced out. The wisdom of working people is infinite!"

In an instant, the public channel lost a lot of people.

Drop drop!

The automatic fishing net sounded a beep again, and it netted a material box.

Xiao Yi left the island monument, walked to the material box, and opened the waterproof strip.

"Acquisition: Water purifier manufacturing drawing (A-grade), chocolate 200g*1."

The water purifier can be found on the construction page of the island monument.

[Water purifier] Determine the material according to the manufacturing drawings.

Xiao Yi opened the drawing: "Manufacturing drawing of water purifier (Class A): glass*8, linen*8, charcoal*8, metal sheet*8."

Looking at the materials that he had never seen before, Xiao Yi shook his head helplessly. It seems that the water purifier still needs to wait to be built. Fortunately, he still has two bottles of mineral water.

Scientific research shows that a person can only last for three days without drinking water, and can last for nearly a month without eating and drinking water!

Therefore, the priority of making water purifiers is the highest!

Xiao Yi put away the water purifier manufacturing diagram, and then looked at the two empty material boxes.

"If it can be disassembled, it should be able to make a wooden house that shelters from the wind and rain!" Xiao Yi thought while touching his chin.

chapters.content_html:
Although the sun is shining brightly now, Xiao Yi doesn't think the weather at sea will always be so beautiful!

Drag the two material boxes to the middle, Xiao Yi prepared to violently disassemble them.

"Bang!"

Xiao Yi kicked one side of the material box!

"hiss!"

The material box was kicked, but it was not broken at all, but Xiao Yi's feet were already numb!

"It's really strong!" Xiao Yi said with emotion, "Come again!"

"Clap! Bang bang!"

No matter how Xiao Yi punched and kicked, he couldn't open the material box.

"Oh, let's forget it!" Xiao Yi shook his painful palm, and finally gave up.

Relying on the island monument, blocking the two material boxes on both sides can be regarded as blocking the sea breeze on three sides. Let’s make do with it first!

Xiao Yi just arranged the positions of the two empty material boxes. Didi, the automatic fishing net once again prompted that the material boxes were caught.

"Three, I should be the person who got the most supply boxes in the world!" Xiao Yi thought so, and then opened the supply box.

"Get: Glass*4, Metal Sheet*2, Apple (Grade A)*2, Soil (Grade A)*1."

"The apples and the soil are still graded?" Xiao Yi looked at the supplies he got when he opened the supply box this time in surprise.

"Any materials without a marked level are basic materials, and the default is D level."

Hearing the system's answer, Xiao Yi asked suspiciously, "What do you mean by graded apples? Does it taste different?"

"Grades are more palatable and can improve personal fitness."

"So amazing?" Xiao Yi said in surprise, then picked up an apple and took a bite.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Multipurpose Toolbox, Trading
chapters.content_html:
With the sign-in system, Xiao Yi is confident that he can survive, and only hopes to contact An Ran as soon as possible!

Of course, even if An Ran was contacted, it was hard to say exactly where she would be.

Xiao Yi must be able to build a big ship, so that it is possible to sail the sea and find her position!

So there is still a long way to go, and I can only pray that An Ran can read her message as soon as possible, and that she will develop to the conditions that she can build a ship as soon as possible!

At this time, the sky was getting dark, and the sea breeze was blowing, and Xiao Yi couldn't help shivering.

"It's dark, it's so cold!"

"It's thiocyanate, it's too hard to make a fire!"

"On the basis of this little thing on the island, I advise you not to try to make a fire, it's useless! It's more realistic to dig a hole and lie in there when you have time!"

"Buried yourself?"

"Aren't you stupid, dig a hole and hide in it, at least it's not so cold!"

"Will it dig through the island and submerge myself?"

"I've tried it, probably not."

"How did you dig? Do you use your hands?"

"You can use your feet if you can!"

"I'm so hungry, I don't have the strength to dig, what should I do?"

"It's up to you, anyway, if you catch a cold the next day and have a fever, just wait to die!"

Xiao Yi watched them chat and sat in the already empty supply box.

The three material boxes and the island tablet were all surrounded on all sides, forming an independent space. Xiao Yi sat in the material box.

Although the legs should be placed outside, it can be considered as a shelter from the wind and rain, but the box is too hard and a little awkward.

Compared with other people who can only dig holes with both hands to hide, he is already far ahead.

Watching more and more people begging for water and food on the public channel, Xiao Yi knew that if they didn't get the supplies after a while, these people would definitely fall into an endless loop.

As the level of hunger deepens, they will not have the strength to net those material boxes, and if they cannot reach the material boxes, they will become more and more hungry!

"This may really kill people!" Xiao Yi frowned, but now he can't do anything.

As for helping others, Xiao Yi didn't even think about it, and he didn't know how many days he could live.

Xiao Yi fell asleep in a daze.

The next day, Xiao Yi was awakened by the sound of the waves and pushed aside the empty supplies box. The calm sea had some ups and downs yesterday.

"Isn't the high tide going to flood my island?" Xiao Yi was a little flustered.

Drip, drip, drip!

The fully automatic fishing net rang, Xiao Yi put his worries aside, walked over, and found that he had caught three more fish last night, and these three fish were ordinary sea fish.

"The harvest is good, at least you don't have to worry about the food, it's just that there is no device to make a fire!" Xiao Yi said with emotion, "By the way, sign in!"

"Sign in successfully, get a multi-function toolbox!"

"Multi-function toolbox: S-class tools, cutting, cutting, drilling and burning, omnipotent, the only disadvantage is that it requires manual operation, less automation!"

Xiao Yi immediately took it out of the system space, and a suitcase appeared in front of him.

Opening the suitcase, the tools inside appeared in front of him, including utility knives, hammers, chainsaws, burning devices, electric drills, and various drill bits, to name a few!

"With a burning device, you can start a fire!" Xiao Yi's eyes lit up, "Bake a fish first!"

He picked up a pair of scissors from the toolbox and cut open the stomach of an ordinary sea fish. He had never made a fish before, so he could only take out all the contents of the fish's stomach and throw it into the sea.

Then he took out a piece of wood, ignited it with the burning device in the toolbox, and put the processed ordinary sea fish on a branch and roasted it.

The first time I grilled the fish myself, I couldn't grasp the skills at all. The whole wood was burnt before it was baked, and one of the sides was burnt.

Looking at the dark side, Xiao Yi felt a little helpless, so he had to eat the other side first.

Although there are no seasonings, the fish is tender and smooth, which fully satisfies Xiao Yi's appetite, and there are very few thorns.

After eating half of the grilled fish, Xiao Yi stopped when he was 60% full.

Although there is food now, but you can't let go of your stomach to eat it, save the rest first!

Part of the reason was that the remaining half was charred.

Cleaned up the ashes from the grilled fish.

"Obtained item: charcoal*2."

"Isn't this the material needed to make a water purifier?" Xiao Yi put away the two pieces of charcoal in surprise.

The water purifier needs 8 pieces, which is to burn three pieces of wood!

Xiao Yi took out a bottle of mineral water, took a sip, and looked at the sea in the distance.

"If you don't have the pressure of survival, it's not bad to stay on an island like this!" Xiao Yi muttered, "Hey, there's another supply box!"

In the distance, a supply box drifted idly past his island.

Xiao Yi immediately changed the program of the fully automatic fishing net and used the material box as the fishing target.

"puff!"

A large net flew out, accurately caught the material box, and dragged it back.

Xiao Yi stepped forward and opened the material box.

"Items obtained: glass*2, metal sheet*3."

"There's no food?" Xiao Yi was a little puzzled. Could it be that he ran out of luck yesterday?

Originally, opening the material box was like opening a blind box, and no one knew what would be opened.

Fortunately, Xiao Yi's current need for food is not particularly urgent.

Let the fully automatic fishing net automatically search for the target, and Xiao Yi walked to the material boxes with the chainsaw.

"It's much more convenient to have tools!" Xiao Yi muttered, and then divided the boxes into pieces of wood.

"Get supplies: 18 wooden boards!"

"With these, I can build a house for myself!" Xiao Yi thought.

But the only tree on the island was in the way. Xiao Yi walked towards the tree with a chainsaw: "I'll cut it with you!"

"呲~"

With the sound of a chainsaw, the palm tree fell.

At the moment when the palm tree fell to the ground, something magical happened. The whole big tree became a pile of wood, a total of 20 trees were neatly piled up, and there were also a pile of leaves and a few pieces of bark!

Although there are some branches scattered around, it is obviously not a material.

"Get supplies: wood*20, leaves*30, bark*10."

"Can you get these resources by cutting down trees?" Xiao Yi understood a little, as long as some specific operations were performed, specific results would appear.

And this specific result can be obtained without having to deal with it yourself.

It's like getting the manufacturing drawings and materials to make the finished product.

"This should be the function of the island monument, no wonder the system prompts me to protect it!"

Xiao Yi walked to the island monument, ready to build a hut for himself.

Before he started, Xiao Yi discovered a problem, he had no nails!

Although there are master architects in the history of the Xia Kingdom who can build a building with only wood without using any metal, using the legendary tenon-and-mortise structure, but Xiao Yi doesn't understand it at all!

"[10g Charred Grilled Fish] Trade [Glass]*1."

Open the supply box.

"Although it's only the lowest level of housing, at least you don't have to worry about wind and rain."

"What did you say? This island will still be submerged?" Su Wan immediately panicked when she heard this, "I can't swim!"

"That's why I said you need to expand your island quickly." Xiao Yi said again.

"In two days, I managed to pull back a material box, but there is still only one blueprint. I haven't found the cornerstone you mentioned at all!" Su Wan said with a weeping voice.

Xiao Yi replied: "Don't worry, you still have time."

Su Wan slightly sorted out her mood, then said gratefully, "Thank you, if it wasn't for your reminder, I'd probably still be wasting my time here! Don't say anything else, I'll hurry up to eat something and continue catching the material boxes!"

Although she knew that the future was very dangerous, Su Wan did not make excessive demands, such as asking Xiao Yi to give her some water, food, or even cornerstones.

This is also what Xiao Yi appreciates more about her, knowing how to advance and retreat!

After the initial panic, Su Wan, a very independent woman, showed strong tenacity.

Xiao Yi looked at the worn-out fishing net that had fallen to the side, and said again, "Trade your fishing net to me!"

It may be that both parties have not seen the same kind for too long, and the two of them did not close the video chat at the same time.

"Huh?" Su Wan looked at Xiao Yi suspiciously, and then instantly understood, "You want to combine two worn-out fishing nets into one, right! I saw someone proposed this plan on the public channel."

While speaking, Su Wan traded the fishing net to Xiao Yi without any hesitation.

Xiao Yi looked at her transaction and said with a smile, "Aren't you afraid that I will block you with a fishing net?"

"I don't know about others, but you definitely won't!" Su Wan smiled, "No matter what, we've been working together for over a year!"

Xiao Yi gave her a thumbs up and said, "Okay, let's talk later!"

Xiao Yi took the initiative to end the chat, and then switched to the construction page.

[Ordinary Fishing Net] (Class C), required materials: silk thread*200, or worn fishing net*2.

Xiao Yi now has two old fishing nets in his hands. Although one of them has a few threads drawn by him and is used to string fish, the system still recognizes that the fishing net is a worn fishing net.

Click Build, and the two old fishing nets disappear immediately, turning into an ordinary fishing net!

"Ordinary fishing nets: C-level tools, as long as they can be caught, at least you don't have to worry about missing them. The maximum catch radius is 20 meters."

Xiao Yi nodded with satisfaction, it would not leak, and the capture radius had also increased.

Then switched to the private channel and traded the ordinary fishing net to Su Wan.

Su Wan stared at the description of the item, she couldn't believe that Xiao Yi actually traded back an ordinary fishing net.

As long as the item is put into the trading system or sent to the chat interface, there will be corresponding instructions on the island tablet.

On the other hand, Xiao Yi is different. As long as he sees an item, a corresponding description will appear.

"This, this is too precious!" Su Wan originally wanted to let Xiao Yi hold it, but she couldn't survive without the fishing net, and she wasn't the kind of woman who would reach out and ask for anything!

"You take it, I have other ways to fish the material box. Besides, I won't use fishing nets if you stay with me!" Xiao Yi replied, "If you catch something good in the future, you can trade it for a cheaper price. give me!"

Remove all the internal organs and gills of the fish at the seaside. This time there is a toolbox, which is much easier to handle!

Finally, rinse it a little with mineral water. The amount used is very small. Before the water purifier is built, it can only save some.

After rinsing, Xiao Yi put the fish on the grill.

"Barbecue grill (Class C): The firepower is relatively stable and can be used improvised, but you must pay attention to turning it over, otherwise it will still burn, and you need to add wood."

"One piece of wood lasts 2 hours of grilling!"

"It turns out that wood is still a daily consumable!" Xiao Yi muttered, and then added a piece of wood to the barbecue.

Using the ignition device in the multi-function toolbox, Xiao Yi began to turn the fish carefully.

After a while, the smell of grilled fish came out.

"Tsk tsk, the grill is still much more reliable than building a fire yourself! Isn't it difficult to grill fish!" Xiao Yi said proudly.

"Should I remind Su Wan to pay attention to handling food with a **** smell?" Looking at the grilled fish, Xiao Yi thought of the shark.

Then he immediately left a message to Su Wan on the island tablet, explaining the situation.

After finally finding someone to chat with, Xiao Yi and Su Wan probably didn't want any problems with each other.

"It's okay, that's what happened before, it's resolved!" Xiao Yi replied with a smile.

"You're busy first, wait, I'll treat you to grilled fish!" Xiao Yi also heard Su Wan's stomach growling, so he said.

"But I haven't caught anything to exchange with you!" Su Wan was even more embarrassed.

"It's okay, maybe you catch what I want in the next supply box!" Xiao Yi replied.

"Okay, then I'll go fishing first!" Su Wan replied, then left the island monument.

After leaving the island monument, Su Wan looked at the material box that was more than 20 meters away from her, and secretly said, "I must net you!"

According to the direction of the material box drifting, it will be the closest to him after about a minute, about 20 meters.

Twenty meters is already the limit value for her to use fishing nets now. If she can't seize this opportunity, she probably won't be able to net other material boxes today!

There is indeed another material box on the sea, but that material box is a full 50 meters away from him. According to estimates, even if it drifts to the closest distance to Su Wan, it will be at least 40 meters away!

There is no chance at all!

Su Wan looked at the material box closest to her and secretly calculated.

"That's it!" Su Wan shouted secretly, and then tried her best to throw the fishing net out of her hand.

The fishing net flew into the air, then stretched out, covering the material box accurately!

"It's done!" Su Wan said happily, and then began to pull the material box to her island.

"It's so heavy!" Su Wan secretly said, "I hope I can gain something more."

After taking a lot of effort to pull the material box to the shore, Su Wan was almost exhausted, and supporting her exhausted body, she opened the material box.

"Materials obtained: cornerstone*2, bricks*5, mineral water 500ml*1, instant noodles 100g*1."

Su Wan saw the bottle of mineral water at a glance, she licked her already cracked lips, immediately opened the mineral water, and drank half the bottle.

Then she walked to the island monument and asked to speak to Xiao Yi.

Xiao Yi just finished grilling the fish at this time, and it looked pretty good, at least the words were no longer charred fish.

"Grilled fish: 2kg, although there is no seasoning, it is a good thing to fill the stomach!"

"I just netted another material box, which contains 2 cornerstones, 5 bricks, a bottle of 500ml mineral water, and a pack of 100g instant noodles!" Su Wan said a little embarrassedly, "However, I'm too thirsty. I have already drank the water, if you don't mind, I can give you the remaining half of the bottle!"

"If he really doesn't mind, do you really want to trade the half bottle of mineral water to him? Isn't this equivalent to an indirect kiss?" Su Wan shook her head, as if she wanted to get rid of this anachronistic thought.

chapters.content_html:
"Give me all the bricks and keep the rest!" Xiao Yi didn't care about the half bottle of mineral water, and then he traded half of the grilled fish!

I just need bricks in the fireplace manufacturing drawing I just got. The weather is still warm now. If there is winter here, the fireplace must be ready.

"[Grilled fish] *1kg transaction is not available."

Su Wan thought about it, and also initiated a transaction.

"[Brick]*5, [Instant Noodle]*100g, [Keystone]*1 No transaction."

Looking at the transaction initiated by Su Wan, Xiao Yi said helplessly: "Actually..."

"Needless to say, if you accept the deal, I will accept the deal!" Su Wan forcibly interrupted Xiao Yi's words.

"OK!" Xiao Yi decisively agreed to the deal.

Anyway, Su Wan has already obtained the cornerstone before, and she doesn't care about this one. As she becomes more and more proficient with fishing nets, she can at least guarantee that her island will not be submerged by sea water!

Su Wan saw that Xiao Yi had agreed to the transaction, and she also agreed to the transaction, and then said, "Thank you!"

She knew that even so, she still took advantage.

"You're welcome, you can use an empty material box to shield yourself from the wind. Although it's a bit awkward, at least it won't be exposed to the wind and rain!" Xiao Yi reminded.

Su Wan's eyes lit up and replied, "Yeah, I'll move the empty material box over here!"

Xiao Yi looked at the trading market and found that all the items he had listed were offered for trading.

"All agree!"

"Get supplies: Linen*1, Metal Sheet*30."

This time, not only are there enough supplies for the water purifier, but there are also enough supplies for the wooden house, and there are even extra pieces of metal!

Xiao Yi switched to the construction page, thought about it, and built the wooden house first.

Click to build, all the required materials disappear, and a wooden house appears in the island monument.

"Please choose the location of the wooden house!"

Xiao Yi thought about it, put the wooden house in the middle, and included the island tablet in it, so that he could easily check the information at any time.

With Xiao Yi's determination, a wooden house appeared in the middle of the island.

Since Xiao Yi was standing next to the island monument, the wooden house also wrapped Xiao Yi inside, and the sound of the waves outside instantly became much quieter!

Xiao Yi patted the wall of the wooden house, making a thumping sound.

"Sure enough, it's much stronger than what I built myself!" Xiao Yi secretly said.

Although it is a wooden house with only four square meters, although the sparrow is small and complete, there are all windows and doors, although there is only one!

Opening the window, watching the sunset about to fall into the sea, Xiao Yi sighed, "It's beautiful, but it's so dangerous!"

Xiao Yi shook his head and continued to manufacture the water purifier on the construction page of the island tablet, and then placed it in the wooden house.

"Water purifier (Class A): It can purify seawater into pure water. When the supply of seawater is sufficient, it can produce 80ml of pure water per hour. The capacity of seawater in the machine is 2500ml, and the capacity of pure water is 2000ml. Lack of automation, seawater needs to be added manually. !"

"According to the purification efficiency of this water purifier, 1920ml of pure water can be produced in one day, and the pure water capacity is only 2000ml, which means that I have to transfer the pure water in a day, otherwise it may overflow, or the water purifier will not work." Xiao Yi secretly calculated, "Looks like I need some containers!"

Don't throw away the mineral water bottle that you drank before!

After calculating, Xiao Yi took down the container that contained the seawater, walked to the beach, filled it with seawater, and put it back.

The water purifier began to work, and pure water began to appear on the side of the pure water container, falling drop by drop.

"With this, at least you don't have to worry about drinking water!" Xiao Yi secretly said while looking at the accumulation of pure water.

After sighing, Xiao Yi walked out and hung all the fish meat that had been distributed before under the eaves of the wooden house, but there was too much shark meat to hang.

"It's not marinated. If you leave it like this, it will probably go bad after a few days." Xiao Yi frowned at the shark meat.

Xiao Yi was a little reluctant to directly trade supplies.

"Let's taste it first!" Xiao Yi took out a piece of shark meat and grilled it on the grill by the door.

Because only a small piece was cut with a knife, it was baked quickly.

It smelled like meat, Xiao Yi took a bite.

"Wait! Why is there a smell of urine?" Xiao Yi couldn't help but spit it out, and uttered a foul language.

I thought it was a baby, it turns out that shark meat is really hard to eat.

In this case, Xiao Yi no longer hesitated and began to trade these shark meat on the shelves.

"[Shark meat] * 500g transaction [brick] * 20, note: can be traded separately, if there are other manufacturing pictures, private chat with pictures."

Trading separately means that even if you only have one brick, you can trade 25 grams of shark meat.

Xiao Yi didn't put a lot on the shelves at one time, too much is easy to depreciate.

Of course there is a reason, wait for a while and the value of the food may go up.

"Did you see it? Someone in the trading hall is trading supplies with shark meat!"

"What? Did he kill a shark?"

"No, when humans meet sharks in the water, they only get eaten. How could they kill a shark?"

"But how do you explain the shark meat in the trading floor?"

"Maybe he encountered a shark that died suddenly for other reasons. Anyway, I don't believe that everyone can kill a shark when everyone is defenseless."

"Who said we were unarmed? As long as we have wood and metal pieces, we can make a long gun. Don't talk nonsense if you don't understand!"

"I'm talking nonsense? You jump into the sea with a spear, kill a shark and come back and show me!"

"Why show it to you? I'm just saying there's a possibility of killing a shark."

"You are misleading everyone to hunt marine life in the sea. You want to kill everyone!"

"I don't want to talk to a gangster like you, it's boring! I really envy the big guy who can hunt and kill sharks. One shark is enough to eat for many days!"

"What's there to envy, shark meat is hard to eat, okay?"

"It's this time, what do you still care about? Lemon essence upstairs!"

"I've been hungry for two days. The boss donates some shark meat to me. I don't think it's bad."

Xiao Yi looked at the discussion in the public channel and shook his head helplessly. The information he just released to find Anran was submerged in these discussions.

At this time, Su Wan sent a call request again.

"Xiao Yi, did you put the shark meat in the trading floor?" Su Wan asked after connecting.

"Yes, that thing is too unpalatable, it's better to exchange some supplies." Xiao Yi replied with a smile.

Su Wan couldn't help but smile bitterly: "Others are still struggling with food, but you're still picking and choosing. It's true that people are more dead than people, and they have to be thrown away."

"I just have some luck." The luck in Xiao Yi's mouth naturally refers to the sign-in system.

"Luck is also a kind of strength. Let's not talk about it, I have to recharge my batteries and try to get more supplies tomorrow." Su Wan naturally understood it as something else.

Xiao Yi naturally did not explain much, and hung up the call after saying goodbye to Su Wan.

"Oh, it's not a good thing to eat too much!" Xiao Yi rubbed his stomach, a little frowning.

I just need bricks in the fireplace manufacturing drawing I just got. The weather is still warm now. If there is winter here, the fireplace must be ready.
"[Grilled fish] *1kg transaction is not available."
Su Wan thought about it, and also initiated a transaction.
"[Brick]*5, [Instant Noodle]*100g, [Keystone]*1 No transaction."
Looking at the transaction initiated by Su Wan, Xiao Yi said helplessly: "Actually..."
"Needless to say, if you accept the deal, I will accept the deal!" Su Wan forcibly interrupted Xiao Yi's words.
"OK!" Xiao Yi decisively agreed to the deal.
Anyway, Su Wan has already obtained the cornerstone before, and she doesn't care about this one. As she becomes more and more proficient with fishing nets, she can at least guarantee that her island will not be submerged by sea water!
Su Wan saw that Xiao Yi had agreed to the transaction, and she also agreed to the transaction, and then said, "Thank you!"


She knew that even so, she still took advantage.
"You're welcome, you can use an empty material box to shield yourself from the wind. Although it's a bit awkward, at least it won't be exposed to the wind and rain!" Xiao Yi reminded.
Su Wan's eyes lit up and replied, "Yeah, I'll move the empty material box over here!"
Xiao Yi looked at the trading market and found that all the items he had listed were offered for trading.
"All agree!"
"Get supplies: Linen*1, Metal Sheet*30."
This time, not only are there enough supplies for the water purifier, but there are also enough supplies for the wooden house, and there are even extra pieces of metal!
Xiao Yi switched to the construction page, thought about it, and built the wooden house first.
Click to build, all the required materials disappear, and a wooden house appears in the island monument.
"Please choose the location of the wooden house!"
Xiao Yi thought about it, put the wooden house in the middle, and included the island tablet in it, so that he could easily check the information at any time.
With Xiao Yi's determination, a wooden house appeared in the middle of the island.
Since Xiao Yi was standing next to the island monument, the wooden house also wrapped Xiao Yi inside, and the sound of the waves outside instantly became much quieter!
Xiao Yi patted the wall of the wooden house, making a thumping sound.
"Sure enough, it's much stronger than what I built myself!" Xiao Yi secretly said.
Although it is a wooden house with only four square meters, although the sparrow is small and complete, there are all windows and doors, although there is only one!
Opening the window, watching the sunset about to fall into the sea, Xiao Yi sighed, "It's beautiful, but it's so dangerous!"
Xiao Yi shook his head and continued to manufacture the water purifier on the construction page of the island tablet, and then placed it in the wooden house.
"Water purifier (Class A): It can purify seawater into pure water. When the supply of seawater is sufficient, it can produce 80ml of pure water per hour. The capacity of seawater in the machine is 2500ml, and the capacity of pure water is 2000ml. Lack of automation, seawater needs to be added manually. !"
"According to the purification efficiency of this water purifier, 1920ml of pure water can be produced in one day, and the pure water capacity is only 2000ml, which means that I have to transfer the pure water in a day, otherwise it may overflow, or the water purifier will not work." Xiao Yi secretly calculated, "Looks like I need some containers!"
Don't throw away the mineral water bottle that you drank before!
After calculating, Xiao Yi took down the container that contained the seawater, walked to the beach, filled it with seawater, and put it back.
The water purifier began to work, and pure water began to appear on the side of the pure water container, falling drop by drop.
"With this, at least you don't have to worry about drinking water!" Xiao Yi secretly said while looking at the accumulation of pure water.
After sighing, Xiao Yi walked out and hung all the fish meat that had been distributed before under the eaves of the wooden house, but there was too much shark meat to hang.
"It's not marinated. If you leave it like this, it will probably go bad after a few days." Xiao Yi frowned at the shark meat.
Xiao Yi was a little reluctant to directly trade supplies.
"Let's taste it first!" Xiao Yi took out a piece of shark meat and grilled it on the grill by the door.
Because only a small piece was cut with a knife, it was baked quickly.
It smelled like meat, Xiao Yi took a bite.
"Wait! Why is there a smell of urine?" Xiao Yi couldn't help but spit it out, and uttered a foul language.
I thought it was a baby, it turns out that shark meat is really hard to eat.
In this case, Xiao Yi no longer hesitated and began to trade these shark meat on the shelves.
"[Shark meat] * 500g transaction [brick] * 20, note: can be traded separately, if there are other manufacturing pictures, private chat with pictures."
Trading separately means that even if you only have one brick, you can trade 25 grams of shark meat.
Xiao Yi didn't put a lot on the shelves at one time, too much is easy to depreciate.
Of course there is a reason, wait for a while and the value of the food may go up.
"Did you see it? Someone in the trading hall is trading supplies with shark meat!"
"What? Did he kill a shark?"
"No, when humans meet sharks in the water, they only get eaten. How could they kill a shark?"
"But how do you explain the shark meat in the trading floor?"
"Maybe he encountered a shark that died suddenly for other reasons. Anyway, I don't believe that everyone can kill a shark when everyone is defenseless."
"Who said we were unarmed? As long as we have wood and metal pieces, we can make a long gun. Don't talk nonsense if you don't understand!"
"I'm talking nonsense? You jump into the sea with a spear, kill a shark and come back and show me!"
"Why show it to you? I'm just saying there's a possibility of killing a shark."
"You are misleading everyone to hunt marine life in the sea. You want to kill everyone!"
"I don't want to talk to a gangster like you, it's boring! I really envy the big guy who can hunt and kill sharks. One shark is enough to eat for many days!"
"What's there to envy, shark meat is hard to eat, okay?"
"It's this time, what do you still care about? Lemon essence upstairs!"
"I've been hungry for two days. The boss donates some shark meat to me. I don't think it's bad."
Xiao Yi looked at the discussion in the public channel and shook his head helplessly. The information he just released to find Anran was submerged in these discussions.
At this time, Su Wan sent a call request again.
"Xiao Yi, did you put the shark meat in the trading floor?" Su Wan asked after connecting.
"Yes, that thing is too unpalatable, it's better to exchange some supplies." Xiao Yi replied with a smile.
Su Wan couldn't help but smile bitterly: "Others are still struggling with food, but you're still picking and choosing. It's true that people are more dead than people, and they have to be thrown away."
"I just have some luck." The luck in Xiao Yi's mouth naturally refers to the sign-in system.
"Luck is also a kind of strength. Let's not talk about it, I have to recharge my batteries and try to get more supplies tomorrow." Su Wan naturally understood it as something else.
Xiao Yi naturally did not explain much, and hung up the call after saying goodbye to Su Wan.
"Oh, it's not a good thing to eat too much!" Xiao Yi rubbed his stomach, a little frowning.

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Solve internal contradictions and create large tubs
chapters.content_html:
Life is alive, eat, drink and sleep.

Now I don’t have to worry about eating and drinking. Although I don’t have a bed yet, I finally have a wooden house, so I can make do with it!

But Lazar has to solve it. If it is solved directly on his own island, the island itself is not large, and the taste can be imagined.

If it is directly discharged into the sea, in case some strange sea creatures are attracted, it will be enough to drink a pot by yourself!

Others have been hungry for two days, but Xiao Yi has eaten normally for two days. At present, he has reached his limit and urgently needs to solve internal conflicts.

When Xiao Yi was tangled, his private channel lit up again.

"Excuse me, do you want this manufacturing drawing? [Thatched hut] Class D!"

Seeing this manufacturing drawing, Xiao Yi's eyes lit up.

"If you're really sleepy, someone will give you a pillow." Xiao Yi secretly said, and then replied on the chat channel, "Yes! What do you need here?"

"Food and water. 10kg of shark meat, 5 liters of purified water."

Xiao Yi saw the message sent by the other party and said coldly, "Your appetite is too big."

"You can't say that. At present, this manufacturing drawing should only be mine. With this, I believe that the hygiene situation on the island of the boss will be much better." The other party seemed very confident.

Xiao Yi frowned and replied, "The price you asked for is not suitable at all. Since you are not sincere, then forget it."

"I believe you will come to me again!" The opposite said confidently.

Xiao Yi immediately blocked the person and said angrily, "I still don't believe it, I still can't figure it out with just one convenient place!"

Set the fully automatic fishing net to cast without target, and then Xiao Yi is ready to go back to the wooden house to rest.

"Although the space is bigger, but you can only sleep on the floor, it's still a bit awkward!" Xiao Yi muttered, "It seems that I still need to get the manufacturing diagram of the bed!"

In a daze, Xiao Yi fell asleep.

The next day, Xiao Yi woke up naturally and felt the whole body hurt from the floor!

He moved for a while, and then ate the last A-grade apple. After the apple was eaten, heat flowed to his limbs again.

"Comfortable!" Xiao Yi said, and then his brows furrowed again, "Is it really necessary to resolve internal conflicts in the open air!"

"By the way, sign in!" Xiao Yi thought of the system, hoping that the system could help him solve the current problem!

"Sign in successfully and get a fully automatic flush toilet."

"Fully automatic toilet: SS-level furniture, you only need to solve your own internal contradictions, and leave the rest to it. Every time it is automatically flushed, it is automatically cleaned, sterilized and deodorized."

"System, I love you!" Xiao Yi shouted happily, and then prepared to place the automatic flush toilet next to the wooden house.

After thinking about it, Xiao Yi built a small shed based on a sturdy wooden house, at least to ensure that it will not run out when it is convenient for him!

This manual construction directly used up all the metal pieces in Xiao Yi's hands, but there were still a few pieces of wood left!

After the construction was completed, Xiao Yi immediately placed the fully automatic flush toilet that he signed in in the small shed.

After it was installed, a brand new and clean toilet appeared in front of Xiao Yi.

Xiao Yi couldn't wait any longer, and immediately began to resolve internal conflicts.

When Xiao Yi came out of the small shed again, he was still muttering: "The system produced it, it really is a fine product, even the bark will not get stuck and can be washed away."

After coming out, three ordinary sea fish were found in the fully automatic fishing net.

After harvesting the three sea fish, adjust the target to the material box and let the automatic fishing net work by itself.

Xiao Yi returned to the wooden house and looked at the trading hall on the island tablet.

One night, there were actually six people who proposed a deal, a total of ten bricks!

Xiao Yi immediately clicked to agree to the transaction.

"Get supplies: bricks*10."

In addition to the 5 pieces that Su Wan gave him before, there is still 5 pieces left to meet the requirements of the fireplace for bricks, but the fireplace still needs metal pieces!

After thinking about it, Xiao Yi put 500g of shark meat on the shelves again.

"[Shark meat] * 500g transaction [metal sheet] * 25, remarks: can be traded separately, if you have other manufacturing pictures, private chat with pictures."

"See? Shark meat is on the shelves again!"

"It won't be the big guy from before, right?"

"I feel very possible!"

"Yes, if it is really a shark, there must be more than a little shark meat."

"Everyone else is eating meat, I haven't found anything to eat, I'm starving to death!"

"I need water, and if there is no more water, I will drink sea water!"

The public channel once again had a heated discussion over shark meat.

This time, Xiao Yi did not immediately release the news of looking for Anran, but waited for everyone to discuss it and then released it, at least to keep it for a while!

After releasing the information, Xiao Yi looked at the soil and apple seeds in stock, and secretly said, "It should be planted!"

If A-grade soil is thrown on the island, the fertility will continue to flow away, and the soil's grade will drop rapidly, so Xiao Yi must find a container that can be used for planting.

The drawing of the wooden tub that was opened from the material box before came into Xiao Yi's eyes.

"Tub manufacturing drawing: wooden board*4, metal sheet*6."

There are still enough wooden boards, but there is still a shortage of metal pieces. There is no way but to hope for the material boxes and transactions that will be caught next.

Drop drop!

The fully automatic fishing net sounded the sound of catching the target, Xiao Yi walked over and opened the material box.

"Get supplies: cornerstone*2, plastic*4, metal sheet*2, bread*100g."

"It's a good start, the first material box will have food!" Xiao Yi said happily, and then used the cornerstone to expand his island, anyway, there is no other use to keep it.

The area of ​​the island has been expanded to 15 square meters, which is much larger than the original 4 square meters.

"If there are enough cornerstones, can I spell out Xia Kingdom's territory completely?" Xiao Yi thought about it, and then shook his head again.

The Xia Kingdom has an area of ​​9.6 million square kilometers. Converted to square meters, it is 9600000000000. Xiao Yi does not want to count the number of zeros. It is an astronomical number anyway!

"Let's go slow and down-to-earth!" Xiao Yi said, taking apart the empty material box and obtaining 6 wooden boards.

He glanced at the trading floor and found that four people had already proposed a deal with metal sheets, and Xiao Yi immediately agreed.

"Get supplies: Metal Sheet*4."

The materials are complete, and the wooden tub can be made. Xiao Yi switches to the manufacturing page, clicks on manufacture, the materials disappear, and a large wooden tub appears.

Xiao Yi took out the wooden basin from the island tablet and said in surprise, "So big?"

"Wooden basin: the most common large wooden basin, you can use it to hold water, wash vegetables, and even take a bath. Of course, you can also use it as a large flower pot!"

Xiao Yi felt that he could lie down and take a bath, but now the amount of pure water is not enough to take a bath, so it is more reliable to use it to grow apple trees.

Xiao Yi also broke the core of the apple he just ate, but he didn't get the apple seeds, which means that whether you can get the apple seeds depends on your face!
